title: Show Resolved DBs (debug)
summary: Prints which database(s) drag-lint would actually use for a given project, file, or platform, without running a real query
intro: Read this when a query seems to answer from the wrong index: it prints which database(s) drag-lint would use for a project, a file or a platform, without running a real query.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Show Resolved DBs (debug)...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Show Resolved DBs (debug)...
Read the list of databases it would use; no query is run

surfaces.usage: drag-lint resolve-dbs [--platform win32|win64] [--repo <file>] [--config <path>] [--json] (print the consumer DB list query/lsp/serve would use)
help: drag-lint resolve-dbs [--platform win32|win64] [--config <path>] [--json]   (print the consumer DB list query/lsp/serve would use)

drag-lint resolve-dbs --project <file.dproj> [--repo <file>] [--config <path>] [--json]   (print the ONE db that owns this project -- the WRITE target; names the field repository it finds, or --repo <file> when given)
exits 2 and names the sections when none or SEVERAL claim the project,
rather than guessing: `index --rebuild` against a wrongly-picked db
clears an index that was never meant to be touched.
the READ list (what hover / Find Usages / the LSP would open for that
file): the ACTIVE PROJECT's db first, then the folder-matched db.
Omit --project to model "no project active". Same resolution the IDE
uses, so this is how it is verified without an IDE.
No covering index: stdout empty ([] with --json), exit 0, a NOTE on stderr.

pitfalls: never guess a DB path. Also --project `<P.dproj>` and --platform `<win32|win64>`. Read-only: a DB that is not built yet stays on stdout as a bare path, with a stderr NOTE that marks it (missing) and prints the exact index command.

The IDE plugin can add one per-user reference index (since 1.54): %APPDATA%\drag-lint\drag-lint-plugin.ini, section [Databases], keys ReferenceDb (the file) and ReferenceDbFor (a part of the path of the project index it applies to). Missing file, key or database = off; the CLI does not read it.

questions.ask: Which index database will drag-lint use for this project?
Which database does it use for a platform or a single file?
